title: Wonder Boy III: The Dragon's Trap
japaneseTitle: モンスターワールドII ドラゴンの罠
shortDescription: Westone's peerless 8-bit non-linear adventure on Master System, pioneering animal transformations and interconnected world design.
historicalSignificance: Universally recognized as the crowning artistic and technical achievement of the Sega Master System, establishing non-linear open-ended platforming (early Metroidvania design) on 8-bit hardware.

editorialContent.overview: Picking up immediately during the climactic boss battle of Wonder Boy in Monster Land, hero Hu-Man is struck by the dying Mecha Dragon's curse, transforming him into a half-human, half-lizard creature. He must journey across Monster Land to find the Salamander Cross.
editorialContent.gameplay: Interconnected hub world exploration anchored by five shapeshifting animal forms: Lizard-Man (flame breath), Mouse-Man (climbing checkered walls), Piranha-Man (swimming), Lion-Man (overhead sword swipe), and Hawk-Man (free flight).
editorialContent.technicalInnovation: Pushed the Master System's VDP graphics to render rich, colorful multi-scrolling biomes, featuring an ingenious password save system preserving currency, armor, and transformations.
editorialContent.culturalImpact: Widely cited alongside Super Metroid and Castlevania: Symphony of the Night as a foundational text in exploratory 2D action adventure design.
editorialContent.preservationNotes: Preserved on original Master System cartridges and lovingly remade by Lizardcube and Dotemu in 2017 with hand-drawn art and authentic retro code toggle.

verifiedFactualData.sales: Critical peak for Master System software in Europe and North America
awards: Electronic Gaming Monthly Best Master System Game of the Year 1989
